AdapterDocumentation.description: Administrator-facing behavior documentation, not certified guarantees or provider settings.

AllocationInspection.description: Pending cleanup is a subset of occupied bytes, not additional free capacity.

Capabilities.description: Advertise only implemented operations/formats. Reserved formats are not capabilities.

CommitReceipt.description: Retained for idempotency reconciliation even if its content version is later pruned.

CreateRootRequest.description: Creates a disabled root. Administration must reject destination aliases and over-allocation.

DirectoryCursor.description: Opaque token binds principal/root/directory/revision/filter/limit; server authenticates it.

DirectoryDraftBase.description: Draft/page encoding and deletion/purge semantics are reserved for M3, not implemented here.

DraftEntryIdentity.description: New identities are server-issued and draft-scoped; never infer identity from a path or digest.

DraftEntryReference.description: Validation must check base identity continuity, uniqueness, root and draft ownership.

ErrorDetails.description: Include only details the caller is authorized to inspect.

InstanceHints.description: Null means unknown; these expectations never determine read order.

OperationInspection.description: Authorized operational view. Worker epochs, leases and physical incarnations stay private.

PolicyPreview.description: Apply must reject changed policy or scope state; counts are previews, not capacity promises.

ReadPolicy.description: Sequential order is authoritative. Transfer progress budgets are distinct from connection budgets.

RenameEntryRequest.description: V1 foundation rejects moves across effective-policy or atomic-versioning boundaries.

SetPolicyRequest.description:
Foundation policy edits are restricted to scopes with no published content.
Destructive previews and content transitions are M3 operations.

UploadInspection.description: Extension point: acknowledgement is not independently certified durability.

info.description: Foundation and independent-file transfer API. Only implemented routes appear in paths. Health and OIDC/session endpoints are outside the versioned application API.
